name: live_nullable_column_observes_null_and_non_null
description: A column nullable in the schema is observed both NULL and non-NULL against a live engine, so the analyzer's nullable claim is demonstrated rather than merely asserted
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
query_sql:
-- @name ListUserEmails
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, email FROM users ORDER BY id

columns.name: email
columns.note: nullable in the schema, and this fixture forces the engine to return both states

default: INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (1, 'Ada Lovelace', 'ada@example.com')
INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (2, 'Grace Hopper', NULL)
